guides.title: Three perfect days in San Francisco, Halloween edition
guides.dek: Lakers at Chase Center, a Castro block party on Halloween night, Día de los Muertos altars from SoMa to the Outer Sunset, and an extra hour on Sunday to spend in Golden Gate Park.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Los Angeles: Halloween and the Day of the Dead
guides.dek: Halloween lands on a Saturday and Día de los Muertos fills Sunday, so LA gets a long weekend of costumes, candlelit altars and, with rain likely, some very good museums.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Miami: Halloween weekend
guides.dek: Cafecito on Calle Ocho, a closing-day farewell at PAMM, stone crabs and a costume party on Lincoln Road, then a slow Sunday in Coconut Grove as the clocks fall back.

guides.title: Three perfect days in New York: Halloween, then the marathon
guides.dek: A Friday of museums and Grand Central, a Saturday that ends on Sixth Avenue for the Village Halloween Parade, and a Sunday in Brooklyn cheering the marathon, with an extra hour to spare.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Paris
guides.dek: A long Toussaint weekend of Zurbarán, Cassatt and Cézanne, walk-in bistro lunches, chocolate at Porte de Versailles and chrysanthemums in Montmartre.

guides.title: Three perfect days in London
guides.dek: Agatha Christie arrives at the British Library, Korea fills the British Museum and the Thames goes dark by five. A Halloween weekend of museums, markets, a proper pub and a Sunday roast.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Prague
guides.dek: Candles on the graves, a queen's portrait show at the foot of the Castle, Debussy at the National Theatre and the last farmers' market of October on the river: Prague turns inward, and it suits the city.

guides.title: Three perfect days in Las Vegas: Halloween on the Strip and downtown
guides.dek: A Nevada Day hockey matinee, Metallica inside Sphere on Halloween night, a morning among the red cliffs and a Día de los Muertos Sunday downtown, with an extra hour of sleep thrown in.
